about_the_game:
What is The Righteous Wrong

The Righteous Wrong is a psychological horror game set on Kaldr during the Rule of Three. Three lost souls trek through a wasteland to the Trinity Mountains. These mountains hold the three. Their mission is simple: find the 12, kill them, then summon the ancient one. The entity responsible for the Great Frost. You must prevent the nuclear winter from raging on. If successful, the rule of three will be dismantled and the world will heal again. Or will these souls get lost in their carnal desires? Sex, revenge, or family

The game is a hybrid of survival horror and JRPG games. With inspiration from H.R. Giger to Fallout. The game sucks you into a nightmarish realm where death is easy and life is not a promise but a gift. 

Features 

  • Hollow, grimdark apocalyptic atmosphere 

  • 3 classes with additional recruitable characters 

  • Brutal strategic gameplay 

  • Element of randomization

  • Turn-based soul combat system

  • Monochrome hand-drawn art style

  • Ambient soundtrack 

  • Major areas require keys to unlock 

  • Transverse the three realms to unlock secrets

The world of the righteous wrong is dark. THE GAME IS ONLY FOR MATURE AUDIENCES! From gore to extreme violence. This game sucks you into its grimdark world. There is drug and substance abuse, sexual violence, cannibalism,  and suicide. All these themes are designed for worldbuilding and are not taken lightly. The game allows you to do anything from murder to stealing. It's all about how willing the player is to accomplish their goal. 

Parts of the map layout, events, loot, and enemy locations are randomized with a few variations to keep things new with playthroughs. Trial and error is an important aspect of the game. Expect to constantly replay until you can master the world you are now in. 

Combat is turn-based, similar to classic role-playing, although it has its own twist. 

You can target a thing called Aspects in the game. Aspects are the soul’s fighting spirit. They will help by casting effects in battle. They must be killed to defeat enemies. Once killed, the player may release or steal the soul. But if the aspect is killed, the enemies will go into a frenzied state, losing all regard for their safety. This goes for you as well. While your aspect isn't actively a part of the battle. If you lose a battle.   The player character will be lost in Enki.  The realm in between. The player must traverse this realm looking for fragments of their soul and then return to  Enlil the physical realm.  Preparing properly will keep you alive in the long run. There are many ways to become strong enough to face off against the ancient one and its children. Crafting and finding weapons and armor. Replace limbs with biomechanical upgrades. Perform rituals to add extra limbs and appendages. Sacrifice or kill to gain favors with the gods. Steal, torture, and kill. Learn more about items and places by inspecting them. Nothing is impossible, just how much evil are you willing to commit for the greater good?

content_descriptors.notes: This game deals with extreme themes of violence and gore. You can find examples of self-harm and drug/alcohol abuse. It is set in a bleak, dying world with a depressing narrative.
